wish: someone should make a tool that wraps screenshots in a browser window
spec:
Wraps a screenshot (chosen, pasted or dropped) in a light or dark browser window with traffic lights, an address bar and a drop shadow.
Pick the window style, a background (none, soft, ink) and the address text, then Save PNG or Copy; output keeps the screenshot's full resolution.
It does not capture the screen itself or upload anything; everything stays on the device.
notes: Preview is the exported PNG as an image, so it can be long-pressed to save on phones.
